# Augur.edu

> Augur.edu is a Nigerian academic platform that predicts university admission chances from JAMB, Post-UTME and O'Level scores, forecasts CGPA from CA and exam scores, and provides readable lecture notes for every NUC course code alongside an AI study buddy.

Augur.edu serves Nigerian secondary school leavers, undergraduates and postgraduate students. Everything runs in the browser and results can be saved to a student profile.

## What Augur does

- Admission predictor: applies each university's screening formula (for example LASU's 50% JAMB, 30% Post-UTME, 20% O'Level) across 40+ federal, state and private Nigerian universities, including indigene bonuses where they apply, and exports a PDF report.
- CGPA forecaster: converts continuous assessment (0-30) and exam (0-70) scores per course into letter grades, semester GPA and projected cumulative CGPA on the 5.0 scale.
- NUC course library: full lecture notes, key terms, exam tips and a comprehension check for every course code in the NUC catalogue, with verified reading XP.
- Augur AI study buddy: text and voice chat covering JAMB drills, past question patterns, A-grade study blueprints, term paper and lab report structure, plus PDF and image flashcard generation.
- Personal study workflow: weekly study plan tuned to a target CGPA, daily streaks, milestones and a log of every course read.

## Key pages

- /: overview of every Augur tool
- /predictor: Nigerian university admission predictor
- /cgpa: CGPA forecaster
- /library: NUC course library
- /study-plan: personal study workflow and streaks
- /chat: Augur AI study buddy
- /how-it-works: how the prediction models work
- /upgrade: premium plans, paid by naira bank transfer

## Notes

- Coverage is Nigeria-specific: JAMB, Post-UTME, WAEC/NECO O'Level, NUC BMAS course codes and the 5.0 CGPA scale.
- Predictions are statistical guidance, not admission guarantees.
